brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has floated the use of cryptocurrency as a potential means to bypass international sanctions, according to Al Jazeera English. The proposal reflects mounting pressure on Israel's economy from existing restrictions and the search for alternative financial mechanisms.

Netanyahu's suggestion represents an unconventional approach to managing economic constraints imposed through traditional financial channels. Details of the cryptocurrency scheme remain limited.
dek: Netanyahu floats Crypto to bypass sanctions…
title: Netanyahu explores cryptocurrency to circumvent international sanctions
